purpose: Final pre-production audit. Third full pass. Builds on 2026-06-14 and 2026-06-15 audits (both reached 'ready'), with PRIMARY FOCUS on the large body of feature code that landed AFTER the 2026-06-15 'ready' verdict and has never had a full audit: Electron desktop app, PWA + offline circulation queue, persistent login, email verification, barcode scanning, idempotency keys, admin-host routing, Resend email driver, desktop printing/auto-update/download-gating.
resume_protocol: A fresh session continues with ZERO loss by: (1) reading this STATE.json; (2) running any gate whose status != 'done'; (3) running any dimension whose status != 'done' (each writes findings/<id>.json + findings/<id>.md, THEN flips its status here to 'done'); (4) once all gates+dimensions are 'done', writing FINAL-REPORT.md and flipping final_report to 'done'. Never re-run a 'done' item. See RESUME.md.
lesson_from_prior_audits: Static typecheck/lint/build ALL passed while the admin plane was 500ing at runtime (Reflector DI under tsx). Conclusion: gates alone are insufficient — runtime probing against the live stack (Postgres+Redis are up) is mandatory for any auth/guard/DI-sensitive finding.
